name: OpenCart
description: OpenCart is a free, open-source PHP-based ecommerce platform for building and managing online stores, with no monthly platform fees.
best_for: Small businesses, developers, and agencies who want a free, self-hosted, highly extensible storefront without recurring platform fees.
features: Fully mobile-friendly admin area with product, order, and customer management
36 payment methods built in, with hundreds more available via the marketplace
Module-based system for extending functionality with themes and plugins
OpenCart marketplace offering 13,000+ modules and themes
Support for 40+ languages, including right-to-left languages like Arabic and Hebrew
Built-in sales reporting and marketing tools
No monthly licensing fees since the core platform is free and open source

alternatives.name: PrestaShop
alternatives.description: An open-source ecommerce platform for building and managing online stores.
alternatives.best_for: Merchants and agencies wanting a self-hosted, customizable open-source storefront.

alternatives.name: WooCommerce
alternatives.description: An open-source ecommerce plugin for WordPress used to build and customize online stores.
alternatives.best_for: WordPress users wanting a free, highly extensible ecommerce plugin.

alternatives.name: Shift4Shop
alternatives.description: A turnkey ecommerce platform with a built-in website builder, marketing suite, and multi-channel selling.
alternatives.best_for: Small to mid-sized businesses wanting an all-in-one hosted store builder.

pricing.starting_price: Self-hosted OpenCart core: free; OpenCart Cloud pricing is not publicly exposed on the current official page

tiers.name: Open-source self-hosted
tiers.notes: Free download and updates; zero monthly OpenCart license fee.

tiers.name: OpenCart Cloud
tiers.notes: Hosted plans are offered, but stable numeric plan pricing was not exposed on the retrieved official public page.

cons: The core software has no monthly license fee, but self-hosting still requires infrastructure, maintenance, security, backups, and possibly paid extensions or support.
OpenCart advertises multiple hosted Cloud plans but does not expose stable numeric Cloud pricing on the retrieved official public page, so hosted total cost cannot be verified from that source.
